# Writing standard

Before drafting or revising user-facing prose, read [writing-standard.md](./references/writing-standard.md) and follow it.

Apply it to documentation, explanations, and generated markdown. Do not restyle code, identifiers, or project conventions that already make a different choice.

When asked to review text, list concrete violations against that file and revise the text.
